source.method: Read saved XML formula caches and formulas from the currently supplied workbook without editing or recalculating it. Annual values use C:F. Annual EBITDA and net income margins use the workbook percentages; aggregate margins use aggregate income / aggregate revenue. After-carry result is derived using the workbook carry payment timing.

priorDeck.note: PPTX P&L values are stale; workbook saved values govern the statements.

status: Workbook projections; not actual results or guaranteed returns

precision.storage: Original unrounded formula caches retained; exact numeric XML text and formula retained per cell.
precision.display: USD rounded to whole dollars; percentages to one decimal after 15-significant-digit normalization of binary noise. Negative expenses shown in parentheses. Totals may differ from sums of displayed rounded values.
precision.nearZero: Liquidation residuals below USD 0.00000001 are visually blank; raw saved values are retained.
precision.zeroDisplay: Blank numeric cells for zero values and values that round to zero at the displayed precision. Original numeric values remain in calculations and source records. Unknown values and errors are never converted to zero.

afterCarry.note: Carry is an equity allocation, not an operating expense. The annual bridge uses modeled carry payment timing; it is not cash distributed to investors.
